title: Be about to: вот-вот начнётся
description: Be about to: вот-вот начнётся: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Не представлять подготовку как завершённое событие
notes: Be about to start — вот-вот начаться.
Was about to leave не доказывает, что уход состоялся; дальнейший текст может сообщать о прерывании.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: I was about ___ leave when the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: Be about to требует инфинитив с to.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: begin / begun.
exercises.editorial_answer: The show is about to begin.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Она собиралась вот-вот уйти, когда зазвонил телефон.»
exercises.editorial_answer: She was about to leave when the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: Фраза помещает звонок в момент перед ожидаемым уходом.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

accepted: The train is about to leave.

exercises.reference_answer: The train is about to leave.
exercises.editorial_answer: The train is about to leave.
exercises.explanation: Для значения ближайшего действия нужна модель about to leave.

public_payload.passage: The caretaker was about to lock the hall when a volunteer noticed a bag under a chair. They paused to find its owner, who returned a few minutes later. A brief incident report said the hall had already been locked before the discovery. The caretaker corrected the sequence. Preparations to close were under way, but the final action had been interrupted. The eventual closure happened only after the bag was collected.

options.label: A completed closure before anyone noticed the bag.
The cancellation of every future event.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: imminent — ожидаемый в ближайшее время; interruption — прерывание; departure — уход или отправление; preparation — подготовка
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: imminent — ожидаемый в ближайшее время; interruption — прерывание; departure — уход или отправление; preparation — подготовка.

public_payload.passage: The caretaker was about to lock the hall when a volunteer noticed a bag under a chair. They paused to find its owner, who returned a few minutes later. A brief incident report said the hall had already been locked before the discovery. The caretaker corrected the sequence. Preparations to close were under way, but the final action had been interrupted. The eventual closure happened only after the bag was collected.

options.label: After the owner collected the bag.
The text says it never closed again.

exercises.editorial_answer: After the owner collected the bag.
exercises.explanation: Окончательное закрытие произошло после передачи сумки.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Does “was about to lock” prove the door was already locked?

options.label: Yes, about to always means already completed.
Yes, it removes all later events.
No, it describes an imminent action that may be interrupted.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, it describes an imminent action that may be interrupted.
exercises.explanation: Ожидаемое действие и выполненное действие различаются.
